summary: minshop (Fernwood Supply Co.) is an ecommerce app with an admin area and a customer storefront. Saved views: (1) admin dashboard (KPI cards, revenue chart, recent orders, low-stock list), (2) admin orders list with filters and status badges, (3) order detail with refunds panel, (4) product edit form (Gooseneck Kettle), (5) storefront product page. Not captured to stay within 5 views: products/customers/categories/pages/shipping/media/settings admin lists, storefront catalog, cart and checkout.
